title.ko: 회의록과 공식 서신: minutes · action points · I am writing to · please find attached · yours faithfully · regret to inform
title.en: minutes and formal correspondence: minutes, action points, I am writing to, please find attached, yours faithfully, regret to inform

explain.ko: 공식 서신과 회의록은 정해진 형식과 격식 있는 표현을 따릅니다. 서신은 I am writing to ...로 목적을 밝히고, Please find attached ...로 첨부를 안내하며, I look forward to hearing from you로 끝맺습니다. 수신인을 알면 Yours sincerely, 모르면 Yours faithfully를 씁니다. 회의록(minutes)은 참석자, 안건, 결정, 실행 사항(action points)을 객관적이고 간결하게 기록하며 수동태를 자주 사용합니다.
explain.en: Formal letters and minutes follow set formats and formal expressions. A letter states its purpose with I am writing to ..., mentions attachments with Please find attached ... and ends with I look forward to hearing from you. Use Yours sincerely when the recipient is known and Yours faithfully when unknown. Minutes record attendees, agenda items, decisions and action points objectively and concisely, often in the passive.

Writing formal letters
Begin a letter by stating its purpose with I am writing to ... Keep the body concise and mention any attachments. If the recipient is unknown, close with Yours faithfully.

prompt.en: Write four sentences in minutes style covering a decision, action points and the next meeting.

task.model: The committee resolved to approve the budget proposal. The finance officer is to submit a revised version by next week. The action points were recorded with the person responsible and the deadline. The next meeting will be held in the first week of next month.

model_trans.en: The committee resolved to approve the budget proposal. The finance officer is to submit a revised version by next week. The action points were recorded with the person responsible and the deadline. The next meeting will be held in the first week of next month.
